# Lab 10.11: Spanner & Bigtable External Datasets

## What We Are Going to Do
Query Spanner tables from BigQuery through an external dataset, and a Bigtable table through an external table. Both create paid resources, so delete them at the end.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a small Spanner database.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable spanner.googleapis.com
gcloud spanner instances create lab-spanner --config=regional-us-central1 --processing-units=100 --description="BQ lab"
gcloud spanner databases create shop --instance=lab-spanner \
  --ddl="CREATE TABLE Customers (Id INT64 NOT NULL, Name STRING(100), City STRING(50)) PRIMARY KEY (Id)"
gcloud spanner rows insert --instance=lab-spanner --database=shop --table=Customers --data=Id=1,Name=Asha,City=Surat
gcloud spanner rows insert --instance=lab-spanner --database=shop --table=Customers --data=Id=2,Name=Ravi,City=Pune</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create an external dataset for Spanner.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE EXTERNAL SCHEMA lab10_spanner
OPTIONS (
  external_source = 'google-cloudspanner:/projects/YOUR_PROJECT/instances/lab-spanner/databases/shop',
  location = 'us-central1'
);

SELECT * FROM lab10_spanner.Customers;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Every Spanner table appears in the dataset automatically.

3. **[CLI] Create a Bigtable table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable bigtableadmin.googleapis.com
gcloud bigtable instances create lab-bt --display-name="BQ lab" --cluster-config=id=lab-bt-c1,zone=us-central1-b,nodes=1
cbt -instance=lab-bt createtable rides &amp;&amp; cbt -instance=lab-bt createfamily rides info
cbt -instance=lab-bt set rides r1 info:city=Surat info:fare=120
cbt -instance=lab-bt set rides r2 info:city=Pune info:fare=99</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Create a Bigtable external table.** Bigtable external tables must be in a dataset in a matching location, so create one in `us-central1` first.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA lab10_uc1 OPTIONS (location = 'us-central1');
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE lab10_uc1.rides_bt
OPTIONS (
  format = 'CLOUD_BIGTABLE',
  uris = ['https://googleapis.com/bigtable/projects/YOUR_PROJECT/instances/lab-bt/tables/rides'],
  bigtable_options = '{"columnFamilies":[{"familyId":"info","type":"STRING","encoding":"TEXT","onlyReadLatest":true}],"readRowkeyAsString":true}'
);
SELECT rowkey, info.city.cell[OFFSET(0)].value AS city FROM lab10_uc1.rides_bt;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[CLI] Delete the paid resources.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud spanner instances delete lab-spanner --quiet
gcloud bigtable instances delete lab-bt --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Spanner external dataset | All tables visible, queried live |
| Bigtable external table | Column families mapped to columns |
| Location | Dataset must match the source region |
| Cost | Spanner and Bigtable are billed hourly |
